% An article with lists of its packages under extensions of its own,
% beside each list of an earlier build with no .aux: tocloft's
% \newlistof, float's \newfloat, and newfloat's
% \DeclareFloatingEnvironment. The earlier build had no entries: each
% list holds only an \addtocontents write of \oldmark, which this
% document does not define. The stale files stay as they are.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tocloft}
\newcommand{\listexamplename}{Examples}
\newlistof{example}{lop}{\listexamplename}
\newcommand{\example}[1]{\refstepcounter{example}\par\noindent Example~\theexample: #1%
  \addcontentsline{lop}{example}{\protect\numberline{\theexample}#1}\par}
\usepackage{float}
\newfloat{program}{h}{lpr}
\floatname{program}{Program}
\usepackage{newfloat}
\DeclareFloatingEnvironment[fileext=lsc]{scheme}
\begin{document}
\listofexample
\listof{program}{List of Programs}
\listofschemes
\section{First}
Text of the first section.
\example{A new example}
\begin{program}
A program.
\caption{New program}
\end{program}
\begin{scheme}[h]
A scheme.
\caption{New scheme}
\end{scheme}
\end{document}
